## What landed (commit `970cdf99d`, 7 files, +344/−27; not pushed per instructions)

**1. Manifest is disk truth**
- `cart/editor/data/modelPackage.ts:46-50` — `ModelManifest` gains optional `favorite`/`hidden`; `packageToManifest`/`manifestToPackage` round-trip them; `manifestToPackage` (:160-163) re-arms `primitive` from `semanticKind` so a saved primitive package reopens viewable after cold restart (the disk-first lookup would otherwise hand the viewer a record with no geometry source).
- `cart/editor/data/modelPackageStore.ts:65-71` `isMaterialized()`; `:73-92` `updateManifestIdentity(kind, id, {name|favorite|hidden})` — read-merge-write on the real manifest, never clobbers unreadable ones; `:94-131` `copyModelPackage()` — whole-directory copy (manifest + all four blob subdirs, base64-safe, viewerPath remapped when inside the package). All IO via `runtime/hooks/fs`, all paths via `modelPackage.ts` helpers.
- `cart/editor/data/content.ts:200-228` — `modelPackageById` now checks the roster BEFORE the primitive/file synthesizers (disk-backed wins); new `effectiveModelPackage(id, overrides, dupes)` — the one resolver every disk-writing path uses; `visibleModelPackages` (:110-127) dedupes by id (disk wins) and honors manifest `hidden`; `nextPrimitiveDocId` (:230-244) keeps fresh docs from colliding with saved package ids AND names (boot roster dedupes by name — two saved "Model 1"s would drop one); `registerSavedPackage` (:246-251).
- `AppFrame.tsx` save-snapshot (~line 349) resolves through `effectiveModelPackage` — a renamed model's manifest now carries the renamed name; first save registers the package into the live roster and mirrors into `modelDupes` so the gallery updates the same render (`M 112 → M 113` visible in the shots).
- Rename (`AppFrame.tsx` `renameModel`, ~line 1900): writes through to the manifest as you type when materialized; pending (dirty) until first save otherwise; retitles the open doc tab. `favoriteModel`/`deleteModel` write `favorite`/`hidden` through the same door. `duplicateModel` copies the package dir on disk (falls back to session-only with an honest status).

**2. Name field in MODEL FOCUS** — `Inspector.tsx:126-180`: `name` label + `HW_RenameInput` (single-line TextInput on the REGIONS grid, reusing the library's rename input cls) above the model card; edits go through the same `renameModel` write-through path. Inspector resolves via `effectiveModelPackage`, so the card always shows the name the next save writes.

**3. Visible save state** — chip row in the focus panel: `NOT ON DISK` (warning, never-saved) / `UNSAVED EDITS` (warning, dirty) / `ON DISK` (success), plus a `Save` verb running the same `save-snapshot` command. Dirty = mesh-journal depth above a per-model last-save baseline (gizmo/paint/topology/part ops all journal; `AppFrame.tsx` ~197-224, with a skip-one-edge guard so the doc-switch commit's stale journal read can't dirty the incoming doc) + rename marks explicitly. Cleared on save/autosave. Status still names the disk dir on save.

**4. Autosave (bounded)** — `autosaveActiveModelDoc` (`AppFrame.tsx` ~1930): on doc switch AND doc close, a dirty model that already has a package dir auto-materializes (runs before the viewer unmounts so the artifact doors still work); status says `autosaved "<name>"`. Brand-new never-saved docs are never silently saved — their chip stays loud. **No quit-signal door exists in the host** (only `__exit`), so quit-autosave was skipped as instructed, not invented.

**5. Durable favorites/hidden + real dupes** — covered above (manifest fields + `copyModelPackage`).

## User-visible flow
Open/create model → focus panel shows editable name + loud `NOT ON DISK` chip + Save button. Type a name → pending. Ctrl+S / Save button / File→Save → package dir + manifest written with your name, chip flips green `ON DISK`, library gains the model immediately. Edit mesh → chip flips `UNSAVED EDITS`; switching docs autosaves it (already-on-disk only). Rename later (library right-click or the name field) → manifest updated live. Restart cold → the name/favorite/hidden all come back from disk.

## Verification (headless, no desktop)
- `RJIT_MODELDOC=cube RJIT_EDNAME="Durable Crate;Durable Crate Mk2" RJIT_EDKEYS="ctrl,s" ./tools/rjit shot editor --frames 240` → PASS; `cart/editor/data/models/props/primitive_cube_1/manifest.json` reads `"name": "Durable Crate Mk2"` — proves pending-name→first-save AND live write-through in one run.
- Cold restart: `./tools/rjit shot editor` fresh process PASS (`scratchpad/cold_boot.png`, `cold_boot2.png` after the primitive re-arm fix; boot count includes the disk package).
- UI: `scratchpad/focus_panel.png` (name field + `NOT ON DISK` chip + Save; fresh doc correctly opened as Model 2, not the saved cube:1) and `scratchpad/post_save.png` (chip green `ON DISK`, browser count M 112→113, `primitive_cube_2/manifest.json` = "Model 2").

## Blockers / follow-ups
- Quit-autosave: needs a host quit-signal door; skipped by design.
- Reopening a saved primitive cold rebuilds seed geometry (mesh/base.blob readback into the viewer is a later slice — pre-existing; identity was this batch's scope).
- Doc-tab dirty dot: tab rendering lives in `Workspace.tsx` (owned by another agent right now); chip lives in the focus panel per the "and/or" in the spec.
- Test artifacts `primitive_cube_1` (now with manifest) and `primitive_cube_2` remain untracked under `cart/editor/data/models/props/` — data dirs aren't in my owned commit set; harmless, delete if unwanted.</result>
